chunks: Who were driven away from their homes for no other reason than they said: 'Our Lord is God.' And if God had not restrained some men through some others, monasteries, churches, synagogues and mosques, where the name of God is honoured most, would have been razed. God will surely help those who help Him, -- verily God is all-powerful and all-mighty, --
ai.seo_question: Why were believers expelled from their homes according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to validate the legitimacy of diverse places of worship, emphasizing that God’s preservation of order relies on human agency ('pushing back one another'). It underscores the principle that the core cause of persecution against believers is their pure declaration of monotheism, linking historical expulsions to the enduring promise of divine victory for those who actively support God's cause.
